course.title: Physics-I
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: What is the basic principle of platinum resistance thermometer? Discuss the (15) constructional details and working principle of this thermometer.

topics: Heat and Thermodynamics: Thermometry: Measurement of low and high temperature; Constant volume thermometers; Resistance thermometer and thermocouple & radiation parameters. Transmission of Heat: Thermal conductivity of solids and liquids; Thermodynamics: First law of thermodynamics and its application; Adiabatic and isothermal transformation; Work done by a gas; Second law of thermodynamics; Reversible and irreversible; Carnot cycle; Efficiency of heat engines; Entropy and its physical concept; Entropy changes in reversible and an irreversible process, entropy of a perfect gas. Elasticity: Young and Bulk and Modulus; Bending moment; Cantilever; Surface Tension: Surface energy and surface tension; Excess pressure; Capillarity; viscocity: Stoke's law; Poiseuille's equation; Waves and Oscillations: Simple harmonic motion; Superposition principle; Lissajous figures; Free, damped and forced vibrations; Wave motion: Transverse and longitudinal nature of waves; Progressive and stationary waves; Power and intensity of wave motion; Energy of progressive and stationary wave; Interference of sound waves; Wave velocity, group velocity and phase velocity; Reflection, Refraction, Diffraction and Scattering: Reflection, refraction and transmission of sound waves and their applications; Transmission in two and three media; Acoustics of enclosed Spaces: Intensity of sound, Bel, acoustic intensity, architectural acoustics, noise insulation and reduction, sound distribution, sabine's formula; Room acoustics; Design of concert halls, opera house and auditorium; Acoustic energy density and directivity.
_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
classification_notes: প্রশ্নটি প্লাটিনাম রেজিস্ট্যান্স থার্মোমিটারের নির্মাণ ও কাজের নীতি নিয়ে যা, যা সরাসরি সিলেবাসের ১নং মডিউলের 'Resistance thermometer' অংশের সাথে সম্পর্কিত।
verification_notes: প্রশ্নটি সঠিকভাবে 'Resistance thermometer' শিরোনামের অধীনে পড়ে এবং অন্যান্য অপ্ৰাসঙ্গিক টপিকগুলো থেকে সম্পূর্ণ আলাদা।
